source.template: Endomyocardial biopsy synoptic (ISHLT 2004 Acute Cellular Rejection; ISHLT 2013 Antibody-Mediated Rejection pAMR; Dallas Myocarditis Criteria).

fields.label: ISHLT 2004 Acute Cellular Rejection (ACR)
options: Grade 1R: Mild acute cellular rejection (interstitial/perivascular infiltrate with up to 1 focus of myocyte damage)
Grade 2R: Moderate acute cellular rejection (>= 2 foci of infiltrate with associated myocyte damage)
Grade 3R: Severe acute cellular rejection (diffuse infiltrate with multifocal myocyte damage, +/- oedema, haemorrhage or vasculitis)

reference.title: ISHLT 2004 ACR & 2013 pAMR grading and native EMB criteria
reference.intro: ISHLT allograft adequacy requires at least 3 evaluable myocardial fragments (>= 50% myocardium, excluding prior biopsy site, scar, or adipose tissue). Report ACR (0R–3R), pAMR (0–3), Quilty lesions, and ischaemic injury.
reference.note: ExpertPath pages open with your own ExpertPath login; the app holds none of their images.

groups.heading: ISHLT rejection grading & native myocardial differentials
points: ACR (2004): 0R = none; 1R = mild (interstitial/perivascular lymphocytes +/- 1 focus of myocyte damage); 2R = moderate (>= 2 foci with myocyte damage); 3R = severe (diffuse infiltrate, multifocal damage, oedema/haemorrhage/vasculitis).

pAMR (2013): pAMR 0 (H-/I-); pAMR 1(H+) (histologic microvascular inflammation only); pAMR 1(I+) (immunopathologic C4d/CD68 only); pAMR 2 (both H+ and I+); pAMR 3 (severe AMR with haemorrhage, capillary fragmentation, necrosis).
Native EMB: Dallas criteria for active myocarditis (inflammatory infiltrate + myocyte necrosis); Congo red apple-green birefringence + AL/ATTR typing for cardiac amyloidosis.

fields.label: ISHLT 2013 Antibody-Mediated Rejection (pAMR)
fields.default: pAMR 0: Negative for pathologic antibody-mediated rejection
options: pAMR 0: Negative for pathologic antibody-mediated rejection
pAMR 1 (I+): Immunopathologic AMR alone (C4d / CD68 positive)
pAMR 2: Pathologic antibody-mediated rejection (both H+ and I+)

fields.label: Endocardial lymphocytic infiltrate (Quilty effect)
options: Present, Quilty B (extends into underlying myocardium)

fields.label: Native biopsy diagnosis
fields.default: No active myocarditis or infiltrative disease

Non-specific myocyte hypertrophy and interstitial fibrosis (cardiomyopathy pattern)
